# == DO NOT EDIT THE FOLLOWING LINES for the Raspberry Pi Pico VS Code Extension to work ==
if(WIN32)
    set(USERHOME $ENV{USERPROFILE})
else()
    set(USERHOME $ENV{HOME})
endif()
set(sdkVersion 2.3.1)
set(toolchainVersion 15_2_Rel1)
set(picotoolVersion 2.3.1)
set(picoVscode ${USERHOME}/.pico-sdk/cmake/pico-vscode.cmake)
if (EXISTS ${picoVscode})
    include(${picoVscode})
endif()
# ====================================================================================
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
set(PICO_BOARD pico CACHE STRING "pico, pico_w, pico2 or pico2_w")
set(FDS_SUPPORTED_BOARDS pico pico_w pico2 pico2_w)
if(NOT PICO_BOARD IN_LIST FDS_SUPPORTED_BOARDS)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Select pico, pico_w, pico2 or pico2_w")
endif()
if(NOT PICO_SDK_PATH AND DEFINED ENV{PICO_SDK_PATH})
    set(PICO_SDK_PATH "$ENV{PICO_SDK_PATH}")
endif()
if(NOT EXISTS "${PICO_SDK_PATH}/external/pico_sdk_import.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set PICO_SDK_PATH to an EXISTING Pico SDK 2.x; downloads disabled")
endif()
set(PICO_SDK_FETCH_FROM_GIT OFF CACHE BOOL "Never fetch SDK" FORCE)
set(PICO_TINYUSB_FETCH_FROM_GIT OFF CACHE BOOL "Never fetch TinyUSB" FORCE)
set(PICO_NO_PICOTOOL 1 CACHE BOOL "Do not download/build picotool; ELF/bin/hex outputs only" FORCE)
include("${PICO_SDK_PATH}/external/pico_sdk_import.cmake")
project(fds1010_reve C CXX ASM)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
pico_sdk_init()
if(NOT PICO_PLATFORM MATCHES "^(rp2040|rp2350.*)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "RP2040 or RP2350 target required")
endif()
option(FDS_ENABLE_FIXTURE "Enable manual GP15 fixture mode; detector must be disconnected" OFF)
add_executable(fds1010_reve main.c pulse_estimator.c)
target_compile_options(fds1010_reve PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_compile_definitions(fds1010_reve PRIVATE FDS_ENABLE_FIXTURE=$<BOOL:${FDS_ENABLE_FIXTURE}>)
target_link_libraries(fds1010_reve pico_stdlib hardware_adc hardware_dma hardware_irq hardware_clocks m)
# No CYW43/network library: radio is not initialized; no direct GPIO23 writes.
pico_enable_stdio_usb(fds1010_reve 1)
pico_enable_stdio_uart(fds1010_reve 0)
pico_add_extra_outputs(fds1010_reve)

# Separate Pico W application. The original interactive executable is retained.
if(PICO_BOARD STREQUAL "pico_w")
  add_executable(signal_bench signal_bench_main.c pulse_estimator.c)
  target_compile_options(signal_bench PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
  target_compile_definitions(signal_bench PRIVATE FDS_ENABLE_FIXTURE=0)
  target_link_libraries(signal_bench pico_stdlib pico_rand hardware_adc hardware_dma hardware_irq hardware_clocks m)
  pico_enable_stdio_usb(signal_bench 1)
  pico_enable_stdio_uart(signal_bench 0)
  pico_add_extra_outputs(signal_bench)
endif()

# Separate candidate preserves the working finite 1.5 image and host targets.
if(PICO_BOARD STREQUAL "pico_w")
  add_executable(signal_bench_stream signal_bench_main.c pulse_estimator.c)
  target_compile_options(signal_bench_stream PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
  target_compile_definitions(signal_bench_stream PRIVATE
    FDS_ENABLE_FIXTURE=0 FDS_STREAMING=1 PICO_STDIO_USB_ENABLE_IRQ_BACKGROUND_TASK=0
    # Keep multiple 64 byte USB packets in flight. TinyUSB requires the
    # receive FIFO to fit one endpoint transfer to arm the OUT endpoint.
    CFG_TUD_CDC_TX_BUFSIZE=4096 CFG_TUD_CDC_RX_BUFSIZE=1024 CFG_TUD_CDC_EP_BUFSIZE=1024)
  target_link_libraries(signal_bench_stream pico_stdlib pico_rand hardware_adc hardware_dma hardware_irq hardware_clocks m)
  pico_enable_stdio_usb(signal_bench_stream 1)
  pico_enable_stdio_uart(signal_bench_stream 0)
  pico_add_extra_outputs(signal_bench_stream)
endif()
